	ROW(
		"AverageAmount", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Sales'[Amount])),
		"DistinctCountCustomerID", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Sales'[CustomerID])),
		"CountOrderID", CALCULATE(COUNTA('Sales'[OrderID])),
		"MaxPrice", CALCULATE(MAX('Sales'[Price])),

7bcc23338e8023ea1450:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Sales'[Region],
			"SumAmount", CALCULATE(SUM('Sales'[Amount])),
			"VarianceQty", CALCULATE(VAR.P('Sales'[Qty])),
			"MedianPrice", CALCULATE(MEDIAN('Sales'[Price]))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [SumAmount], 0, 'Sales'[Region], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[SumAmount] DESC, 'Sales'[Region]
